verdict.rationale: The Texas Secretary of State's SOSPortal is a government business-filing, ordering and search portal, not an AI host or agent. Acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI assistant or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
